t.name: Cloudy Pass Trail
t.description: This route within Glacier Peak Wilderness is on a good grade for the first 3 miles, staying in the valley of Railroad Creek. It goes around Hart Lake (4 miles) and switchbacks up to Crown Point Falls, Lyman Lake (8 miles), and on to Cloudy Pass.

t.name: Monkey Bear Falls Trail
t.description: The trail crosses 10 Mile Creek on a large foot log with band rails on both sides. As you near the falls, the trail leaves the forest and switchbacks up a rocky ridge to a view point of Monkey Bear Falls.

t.name: 10 Mile Falls Trail
t.description: 10 Mile Falls trail is a fully accessible trail based out of Holden Village. Great for anyone with physical limitations or families with small children. The trail surface starts out brick, similar to the other walking paths in the village.

t.name: Winston Trail
t.description: This is a connector trail that goes through the old residential town site for the Holden Mine. It connects Holden Village to the Glacier Peak Wilderness via the Hart and Lyman Lake Trail #1256.

t.name: Copper Falls Trail
t.description: This is a hiker only trail with very steep grades and a view of Copper Falls.

t.name: Copper Basin Trail
t.description: This hiker only trail is used mainly by people staying at Holden Village. The trail starts surrounded by lodgepole forest and after a mile it breaks into the open, providing great views and continues into subalpine areas within Glacier Peak Wilderness.

t.name: Railroad Creek Trail
t.description: The trail travels from Lucerne up the south side of Railroad Creek towards Holden Village
